source: Start values: docs/design/balance-sheet.md §1. Limits are invented clamps (physical sanity), not thresholds. Loss term (docs/science/temperature-loss-term.md, SME recommendation accepted by the owner 2026-11-28): each sol the temperature falls by 0.4 percent of its distance above -60 C (a restoring leak toward the starting temperature: heat always leaks to space). perSol 0.004 is INVENTED game balance; the direction is real physics, the real timescale is much longer and NOT VERIFIED. It is a natural rate (scales with pace like the polar frost); thresholds never scale.
